title: Invertible modules over principal ideal domains are trivial
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative integral domain in which every ideal is generated by one element. Let $M$ be an $R$-module. Put $M^\vee=\operatorname{Hom}_R(M,R)$, and use the tensor product of [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Assume that the evaluation map $M^\vee\otimes_R M\to R$, $\varphi\otimes m\mapsto\varphi(m)$, is bijective. Then there exists an $R$-linear isomorphism $M\cong R$.
